core_question: How do I clean white leather sneakers that have gone yellow/gray?
answer_summary: Mix a small amount of mild soap with warm water, scrub the leather with a soft-bristle brush or cloth, wipe off residue, and use a melamine (magic) eraser on stubborn scuffs; air dry away from direct heat.
persona: tired and blunt; writing in full careful sentences
